response.response:
When you are at work, staying in a Beautiful State begins with awareness. Notice when your thoughts become self-obsessed or entangled in stress, fear, or frustration. As Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji teach, when you bring attention to these patterns, you naturally shift into a Beautiful State. This state is not something you search for; it arises when you see the truth of your inner engagement with suffering.

In this state, clarity emerges, and intelligence flows into you. You gain strength, courage, and vision to address challenges effectively. Suffering dissolves, and calm, joy, and connection take its place. From this space, your actions become spiritual—rooted in peace rather than anxiety or fear.

To sustain this at work, pause throughout your day to observe your inner state. When you notice stress or negativity, gently bring your attention to the truth of your experience. Allow the Beautiful State to arise naturally. Act from this place of calm and clarity, and you will find solutions flow effortlessly.

Reflect: How can you bring this awareness into your daily tasks?

_What this teaching does not establish: it is not a treatment for OCD, anxiety, addiction or any other health condition, and it does not replace professional care; it does not promise a particular result, and experiences differ._

_Apart from words in quotation marks, this is a summary of the teachings in our own words, not a direct quote._

The Nature Of Oneness And States Of Being

# The Nature Of Oneness And States Of Being

## Verbatim Discourse Excerpts
If you want to stop the chaos of your life and take your life towards harmony and peace, you must bring attention to your state. If you are in a Suffering State, states of anger, anxiety or sadness, you draw chaotic events into your life. While if you are in beautiful states of joy, connection or peace, you will largely draw harmonious events to yourself.

If you are in an awakened state, a state of oneness, you rise beyond pain and pleasure, fear or gratification and blessings flow to those around you. Now what is oneness? At its first level, oneness is a state where there is no conflict. At its second level, oneness is a state of no disconnection. At the third and ultimate level, there is no separation or division.

## Key Teachings
- If you are in a Suffering State, states of anger, anxiety or sadness, you draw chaotic events into your life. — Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji
- While if you are in beautiful states of joy, connection or peace, you will largely draw harmonious events to yourself. — Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji

# Communication With The Universe

## Verbatim Discourse Excerpts
If you are living in a Beautiful State, it means you are signaling consciousness that you are open to solutions and order in your life. Firstly, let us understand that this universe is a living universe. It is a conscious universe. There is an immense communication that is going on all the time with each life form and from one life form to another life form and from various life forms to the whole within the human body.

The spores of these ferns open up only when a certain kind of birds sing. If the entire universe is communicating, how are we human beings communicating to this magical field of consciousness? We do not communicate through our words. We do not communicate through our actions and mannerisms. With the universe, we communicate through our state of consciousness.
